metadata.intro: The quantum mechanical program replaces the deterministic trajectories of classical physics with the probabilistic evolution of state vectors within an infinite-dimensional Hilbert space. From the historical resolution of the ultraviolet catastrophe to the rigorous axiomatic formulation of the measurement postulate, this roadmap navigates the non-local correlations, operator algebras, and wave-particle dualities that define the subatomic regime.

bridges.classical-mechanics: The correspondence principle ensures that quantum expectation values follow Newtonian trajectories in the macroscopic limit, as formalized by Ehrenfest's Theorem.
bridges.relativity: The unification of quantum mechanics and special relativity necessitates a covariant field-theoretic approach, leading to the Dirac equation and the prediction of antimatter.
bridges.theoretical-physics: The mathematical foundations of quantum theory, including spectral theory and group representation, provide the primary toolkit for modern gauge theories and the Standard Model.

pillars.title: 1. Foundational Principles
pillars.narrative: The historical transition from classical continuity to discrete energy levels, established through the resolution of the photoelectric effect and blackbody radiation.

pillars.title: 2. Analytical Framework
pillars.narrative: Rigorous derivation of the wave function's statistical interpretation and the mathematical requirements of square-integrable Hilbert space states.

pillars.title: 3. Modern Frontiers
pillars.narrative: Advanced explorations into the de Broglie hypothesis and the topological constraints on wave diffraction within the quantum manifold.
